title: Search for the Double Poles of the Scattering Matrix in Light Nuclei
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) are non-Hermitian degeneracies at which two eigenvalues and their eigenvectors coalesce, producing a defective Hamiltonian and a double pole of the $S$-matrix. Using the coupled-channel Gamow Shell Model with the $\ell=1$ spin-orbit strengths as control parameters, we locate and characterize EPs in $^6\text{Li}$, $^7\text{Li}$, $^7\text{Be}$, and $^8\text{Be}$, and analyze their imprint on energies, widths, phase rigidity, spectroscopic factors, elastic cross sections, survival probabilities, and spectral functions.
